_comment: Install guidance per platform for builds that are not signed with the brand's own key. Whether a build IS signed comes from its release-metadata.json (signing: release|debug|ad-hoc|none), written by the build that signed it; this file is only the fallback for older builds and the words shown for unsigned ones. Resolution: overrides['<brandId>/<platform>'] wins, else defaults['<platform>']. {APP} is replaced by appName. Store links come from each brand's contract (site: play-store, app-store, testflight, ...), never from here.

unsigned.headline: Unsigned build — safe, but macOS will ask you to confirm
unsigned.reassurance: This is an independent build that isn't notarized by Apple yet. The app is the same artifact CI produced — verify its SHA-256 if you want certainty. The steps below tell macOS you trust it.
steps: Download the .zip below and double-click to unzip it.
Drag the app into your Applications folder.
macOS may say it "cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified" — that's expected for an un-notarized build, not a sign of danger.
Open Terminal and run the command below to clear the quarantine flag, then launch the app normally.

unsigned.headline: Unsigned installer — safe, but SmartScreen will warn
unsigned.reassurance: This installer isn't code-signed with an EV certificate yet, so Windows SmartScreen flags new publishers. The build is the same artifact CI produced.
steps: Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" — click "More info".
Click "Run anyway", then follow the installer.

unsigned.headline: Portable build — extract and run
unsigned.reassurance: A self-contained tarball. No installer, no root needed.
steps: Make the binary executable and run it from the extracted folder.

unsigned.headline: Direct APK - Android will ask you to allow it
unsigned.reassurance: This APK comes straight from CI, not from a store. Until it is signed with the brand's own key it cannot update a store-installed copy, so install one or the other.
steps: Download the .apk below on your Android phone.
Open it. Android asks to allow installs from your browser or Files app - allow it for this install.
Tap Install. If Play Protect asks, choose Install anyway.

unsigned.headline: Unsigned .ipa - for sideloading from a computer
unsigned.reassurance: iPhone and iPad only run signed apps. The signed build goes to TestFlight; ask for beta access on this page to be invited. This .ipa is for people who sign it themselves.
steps: Easiest: tap Beta under Try it early on this brand, and you will get a TestFlight invite.
Or download the .ipa below on a Mac or PC.
Install it with Sideloadly or AltStore using your Apple ID (a free Apple ID runs it for 7 days).
